name: 48840 · Haslett, MI
findings: ZIP 48840 (Haslett) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (53% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48840 (Haslett) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
